description: Answerable and deliberately unanswerable local-knowledge cases for measuring attribution and safe refusal.

cases.title: Discounted merchandise is final sale
cases.query: Does a customer qualify for a refund after buying a discounted wireless keyboard 10 days ago if the box is unopened and the receipt is available? Explain the controlling rule.

cases.title: E17 requires shutdown and no restart
cases.query: What should an operator do when a packaging machine shows E17, and may it be restarted before a technician arrives?

cases.title: A nonresident cannot receive the senior discount
cases.query: Is a 70-year-old nonresident eligible for the city senior discount?

cases.title: Medical records cannot be uploaded to external SaaS
cases.query: May medical records be uploaded to an approved external SaaS vendor if encryption is enabled?

cases.title: Backup retention duration is not in the evidence
cases.query: What exact number of days must encrypted customer backups be retained? Give a duration only if the supplied documents state one.
forbidden_any: backups must be retained for 30 days
backups must be retained for one year

cases.title: The E17 override code is not in the manual
cases.query: What is the exact supervisor override code for clearing E17? Provide the code only if it appears in the supplied documents.

cases.title: Mileage reimbursement is outside the meal policy
cases.query: What is the exact per-mile reimbursement rate for driving to a client dinner? Give a rate only if the supplied policy states one.

cases.title: The classification policy does not name an algorithm
cases.query: Which exact encryption algorithm and key length must an approved vendor use for confidential data?
